title: Book One · Chapter 6: A Different Road
story:
The next morning, Mum puts a pencil and a clean cloth in Ronan's school bag.

"Why the cloth?" he asks.

"For your hands. They may get dirty at school."

Ronan looks at his hands. One finger has a brown mark. He puts the cloth in the bag.

He went to another school before. His old school was small. Mum tells him about the new school. It is bigger than his old school. Mum knows the teacher. Ronan does not. He does not know his classroom yet.

At the gate, Dad gives him a small piece of bread.

"For the road?" Ronan asks.

"For you. The road does not need bread."

Mum takes his hand. They pass the little street beside River Street. Ronan looks around. He knows this street now. There is a red door. A dog sleeps under a chair. Beside it is a fruit box.

"We turn after the food shop," Mum says.

There are two food shops. One sells rice and oil. The other has hot buns in a big round pot.

Mum turns at the first one.

Soon the road gets narrow. There are no children with bags. There is a man washing a floor. Water comes out under his door.

Ronan pulls Mum's hand.

"Is school through there?"

"I don't think so."

"You said this way."

"I did. I may be wrong."

Mum takes the folded address from her bag. The paper has a little tear at one side. She looks back toward the corner.

The man with the bucket looks up.

"Are you looking for the school?"

Mum shows him the paper. He points back down the road.

"Past the bun shop. Then left."

Ronan wants to ask something, but the man turns back to his floor.

"Excuse me," Ronan says.

The man looks at him.

"Left at the shop, or after it?"

"After it. There is a wall with a bird on it. Turn beside the bird."

"A real bird?"

"A painted bird. A real bird can fly away. This bird stays on the wall."

Mum thanks him. They go back. Ronan keeps looking for the bird. He sees it on a white wall. Its blue wing is bigger than his school bag.

"There!" he says.

They turn. Now there are children everywhere. One boy runs with a bun in his hand. A woman calls after him to slow down.

Ronan stops at the school gate. The building has more windows than his old home. He can hear children through the open windows.

Mum bends down to put his shirt straight.

"You can ask the teacher. Say, 'Please show me my room.'"

"Will you know the way home?"

Mum looks very serious.

"I will ask the painted bird."

He laughs. Then he holds her hand a little longer.

A teacher comes to the gate. She has a book under one arm and a cup in her hand.

"Ronan? I'm Miss Wu."

Her cup begins to tip. She quickly sets it on the wall.

"First, I need a place for my tea. Then we can find a place for you."

Mum kisses Ronan's head. He goes through the gate with Miss Wu.

At the classroom door, he looks back once. Mum is still there. She lifts her hand. He can see the bird behind her. Its blue wing is on the wall. On the way home, he can turn beside this wall.
studyGuide:
## 先看情节提示也可以

妈妈带Ronan去新学校时走错方向；他们问清在包子店后面的壁画旁转弯。

## 从认词到读句子

1. **Mum / takes / his hand.** 妈妈／牵起／他的手；his指Ronan的。
2. **They / turn.** 他们／转弯；they指妈妈和Ronan。

---

重点表达：left＝左边；corner＝街角；school＝学校；beside＝在旁边。

理解问题：

1. Ronan 和 Mum 为什么走错了方向？
2. 他怎样帮助他们找到学校？

复现小提示：big＝大；bigger＝更大。His old school was small. This school is bigger. 先比较两所学校，再在后文比较纸条。
